# Furqan: AI chatbots for real-estate websites

> Furqan is an agentic AI engineer who builds fixed-price AI chatbots for real-estate websites in the United States. The chatbot answers visitor questions using only the business's own listings, neighborhood information and FAQs, so it does not invent prices or details.

## Offer
- Free demo: a working chatbot trained on about 30% of the site's data, delivered within 48 hours, no payment or commitment.
- The 11pm Lead Catcher: $699 fixed price, live in 7 days. Trained on all listings, website, docs and FAQs, installed on the site, 3 rounds of revisions included.
- Guarantee: 50 real customer questions are tested at launch. If fewer than 90% are answered correctly, it is fixed free until it passes, or the client is refunded.
- Custom tier (RAG + agentic tooling): appointment booking, order status, CRM and internal-tool integration. Quoted after a short call.
- Capacity: 5 new builds per month.
